intro: Paper results evaluate constraint optimization and adaptive scheduling on ten 2D difficulty levels and a 7-DoF arm obstacle-avoidance task.

figures.title: Safety, cost, and runtime across 2D maps
figures.alt: Original paper heatmap of safe and success rate at levels L1 to L10, with cost convergence, final cost, runtime, and all method legends.
figures.caption: Safe & Success Rate at each difficulty level, followed by cost over reverse-diffusion steps, final cost, and planning time. Each level uses 10 random seeds and 20 trajectory modes per seed. Shaded regions show one standard deviation. MD-COAS-A and MD-COAS-F are ablations; the full method is the MD-COAS row.

figures.title: How safety effort adapts during denoising
figures.alt: Original paper plots of the residual-driven augmented Lagrangian duals and adaptive CFS projection scheduling across reverse diffusion.
figures.caption: Safety-enforcement variables over reverse-diffusion steps, averaged across all 2D levels and seeds. Left: iALM dual and penalty updates driven by the feasibility residual. Right: CFS projection probability, iteration budget, active-set size, and compute dual. The plot compares the full method with two ablations.

tables.title: 7-DoF arm obstacle avoidance
tables.caption: Quantitative results as obstacle radius increases. SSR is Safe & Success Rate (↑); V is violation rate (% ↓); T is planning time (↓); P is path length (↓). Means are reported across seeds, with path length averaged over safe and successful trajectories.
notes: Five random seeds and 20 trajectory modes per seed at each obstacle radius: 100 modes per method and level. End-effector radius is fixed at 0.01.
± values are standard deviations, rendered from the original right-superscript notation. The paper reports no standard deviations for SSR or V.
The source table does not specify physical units for T, P, or obstacle radius; these are reproduced as reported.
CFS projection is applied to all unweighted trajectory samples. The paper reports a trade-off between planning performance and computation time.
Hardware: NVIDIA RTX A6000 (48 GB) and 9 CPU cores; CFS projections use jaxopt.
